structure: Part 1 read the whole ruling file, ruling-sam-2026-11-27.md (47 lines): a context line (given while picking up the germinal products theme, after the Design Release 2.1 prototype moved from 04a073b, 5 October, to c2078fb, 26 November); Sam's verbatim quote (two lines: defaults for the open questions; animals dashboard, use what is already there for now; manage notifications theme in flight, may need catching up); a line saying the open questions are the seven in the 26 November report whose rows include germinal products; nine numbered claims the main session read from it (1 to 7 each keep the default for one report question: 7, 9, 15, 20, 21, 28, 35; 8 and 9 are new, on the animals dashboard and manage notifications themes); and the orchestrator's call at the foot, flagged to Sam afterwards. Claims 1 to 7 are recorded as inferred: the quote says only 'defaults for the open questions', and the content of each default is the main session's reading of the report. Each multi-fact listed claim is split into one claim per fact. Claims 8 and 9 are inferred from the quote's dashboard and manage-notifications lines. The orchestrator's call is inferred and marked as not Sam's words. Gaps record what the ruling leaves open: how long 'for now' lasts, who catches up the manage notifications theme, and whether Sam accepted the orchestrator's call.
